title: Reconstruction from Fixed and Free Coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $ br^n$ indexed by $	ext{Fin}(n)$, and let $z$ assign a sign to each coordinate in $P$. If a sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^{[n]}$ agrees with $z$ on every coordinate in $P$, then combining $z$ on $P$ with the restriction of $x$ to the coordinates outside $P$ recovers $x$.

$x$ is a sign vector indexed by $\text{Fin}(n)$
$x$ agrees with $z$ on every coordinate in $P$
